node.title: XR prize arbitrary-rank augmented-orthogonal quotient router
node.statement: The pairing map from any support-minimal rank-r trade row space to the two received directions has rank s in {0,1,2}. Its kernel is the augmented-orthogonal subspace of dimension r-s. At s=1 exactly one row is interactive and t<=2r-1. At s=2 every quotient coefficient is tau_i(-gamma_i,1), so the coefficient-slope quotient lies on a three-dimensional conic span. Thus every arbitrary-rank packet is an augmented-orthogonal lift of a rank-at-most-two interaction quotient. Aggregate lift counting remains open.
